# "board": exposes the generated pin header (main/board_pins.h), the GATT contract header
# (main/proto/caliper_gatt.h) and the pin plan (include/pin_plan.h, pin_plan_table.c generated by
# tools/pin_plan.py) to all components, and checks that the pin header and the pin plan match
# caliper/hardware/design/nets.py so neither can drift.
set(fw_dir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../..)

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "pin_plan.c" "pin_plan_table.c" "pin_plan_apply.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "${fw_dir}/main" "${fw_dir}/main/proto" "include"
    PRIV_REQUIRES esp_driver_gpio)

set(nets_py ${fw_dir}/../hardware/design/nets.py)
if(CMAKE_BUILD_EARLY_EXPANSION)
    # requirements-expansion pass: nothing to check yet
elseif(EXISTS ${nets_py})
    idf_build_get_property(python PYTHON)
    foreach(gen gen_pins pin_plan)
        execute_process(
            COMMAND ${python} ${fw_dir}/tools/${gen}.py --check
            RESULT_VARIABLE gen_rc
            OUTPUT_VARIABLE gen_out
            ERROR_VARIABLE gen_err)
        if(NOT gen_rc EQUAL 0)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "${gen}.py --check failed (generated file does not match nets.py / the plan): "
                                "${gen_err}Regenerate with: python ${fw_dir}/tools/${gen}.py")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    # re-run the checks when nets.py or a generator changes
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${nets_py} ${fw_dir}/tools/gen_pins.py
                 ${fw_dir}/tools/pin_plan.py)
else()
    message(WARNING "nets.py not found; using the committed board_pins.h and pin_plan_table.c unchecked")
endif()
